#!/usr/bin/env python3 """Build business-plan/Stamp-business-plan.pdf from business-plan/copy.md. Prose words are the section paragraphs only. Headings, figure captions, image paths, and markdown tables are not counted. The build stops if that count is outside 1,500–2,500. Branding strictly honors the clean, flat, modern Stamp web platform: - Minimalist Cover Page: Deep Night Ink (#240340) with centered STAMP wordmark, PEEL. PRESS. TOAST., and white Commercial Business Plan at the bottom. - Section Divider Pages: Bold full-bleed colored divider pages cycling across the 4 authentic brand flavour palettes (Yeast, Butter, Raspberry, Peanut), with primary-colored title and concise subtitle, and brand footer. - Content Pages: Pure white (#FFFFFF) background with dark legible ink typography (#1A1024), primary-colored section headings, clickable links (#6D28D9), and brand footer (STAMP wordmark on bottom left, page number on bottom right). - Bold Elevated Containers: Distinct solid surface (#EEF2F6), solid 5pt primary accent bar, and crisp bold typography. Zero wireframe borders. """ from __future__ import annotations import re import sys import tempfile from pathlib import Path import numpy as np from PIL import Image as PILImage from reportlab.lib.colors import HexColor, white from reportlab.lib.enums import TA_CENTER, TA_LEFT from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import A4 from reportlab.lib.styles import ParagraphStyle from reportlab.pdfbase import pdfmetrics from reportlab.pdfbase.ttfonts import TTFont from reportlab.platypus import ( BaseDocTemplate, Flowable, Frame, KeepTogether, NextPageTemplate, PageBreak, PageTemplate, Paragraph, Spacer, ) HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent ROOT = HERE.parent COPY_PATH = HERE / "copy.md" OUT_PATH = HERE / "Stamp-business-plan.pdf" FONT_DIR = ROOT / "brand" / "fonts" MIN_WORDS = 1500 MAX_WORDS = 2500 LEFT = 48 RIGHT = 48 FRAME_BOTTOM = 54 FRAME_TOP = 50 # 4 Authentic Flavour Schemes from website/src/lib/theme.svelte.ts SCHEMES = [ { "id": "yeast", "name": "Yeast Extract", "primary": HexColor("#E24BFF"), # Electric Lavender "secondary": HexColor("#240340"), # Deep Night Ink "tertiary": HexColor("#3B0764"), # Deep Solid Purple "rgb": (226, 75, 255), }, { "id": "butter", "name": "Golden Butter", "primary": HexColor("#FFD640"), # Electric Butter Gold "secondary": HexColor("#4A3000"), # Roasted Caramel Brown "tertiary": HexColor("#2D1D00"), # Deep Umber "rgb": (255, 214, 64), }, { "id": "raspberry", "name": "Wild Raspberry", "primary": HexColor("#FF467A"), # Neon Wild Raspberry "secondary": HexColor("#460820"), # Rich Berry "tertiary": HexColor("#2D0414"), # Dark Berry Maroon "rgb": (255, 70, 122), }, { "id": "peanut", "name": "Roasted Peanut", "primary": HexColor("#FF8C30"), # Roasted Peanut Ochre "secondary": HexColor("#4E2408"), # Deep Peanut Umber "tertiary": HexColor("#2D1403"), # Dark Roasted Nut Brown "rgb": (255, 140, 48), }, ] # Section Titles & Concise Subtitles SECTION_METADATA: dict[str, dict[str, str]] = { "Executive summary": { "title": "Executive Summary", "subtitle": "The Utensil-Free Breakfast Revolution", }, "Product": { "title": "Product Specification", "subtitle": "Four Culinary Varieties & Continuous Deposit Scaling", }, "Market": { "title": "Market Analysis", "subtitle": "New Zealand Supermarket Scan Data & Premium Growth", }, "Competitors": { "title": "Competitor Benchmarking", "subtitle": "Bulk Commodity Jars vs Format Innovation", }, "Customer and brand": { "title": "Customer & Brand Identity", "subtitle": "Modern Mobile Professionals & Bold Minimalist Design", }, "Marketing": { "title": "Marketing & Acquisition Strategy", "subtitle": "Digital-First Launch & High-Impact Sampling", }, "Operations": { "title": "Operations & Manufacturing", "subtitle": "Contract Manufacturing, Cleanroom Packaging & QA", }, "Information": { "title": "Information Systems & Architecture", "subtitle": "Relational Data Architecture & Supply Chain KPIs", }, "Website demo and customer support chatbot": { "title": "Digital Platform & AI Support", "subtitle": "Interactive SvelteKit Web App & Automated Assistant", }, "First 90 days": { "title": "Commercial Roadmap: First 90 Days", "subtitle": "Pilot Production, Regulatory Compliance & Retail Launch", }, } REQUIRED_INPUTS = [ "audio/stamp-jingle.mp3", "audio/lyrics.txt", "diagrams/manufacturer.md", "diagrams/process.png", "diagrams/erd.png", "diagrams/process-notes.md", "diagrams/information-notes.md", ] class SolidParagraph(Paragraph): """Do not split a short paragraph containing a URL awkwardly across pages.""" def split(self, avail_width, avail_height): _width, height = self.wrap(avail_width, avail_height) if height <= avail_height: return [self] if avail_height > 680: return Paragraph.split(self, avail_width, avail_height) return [] def register_fonts() -> None: pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont("Manrope", str(FONT_DIR / "Manrope-400.ttf"))) pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont("Manrope-Med", str(FONT_DIR / "Manrope-500.ttf"))) pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont("Manrope-Semi", str(FONT_DIR / "Manrope-600.ttf"))) pdfmetrics.registerFont(TTFont("Manrope-Bold", str(FONT_DIR / "Manrope-700.ttf"))) pdfmetrics.registerFontFamily( "Manrope", normal="Manrope", bold="Manrope-Bold", italic="Manrope-Med", boldItalic="Manrope-Semi", ) def styles() -> dict[str, ParagraphStyle]: return { "body": ParagraphStyle( "body", fontName="Manrope", fontSize=10.0, leading=15.0, textColor=HexColor("#1A1024"), spaceBefore=0, spaceAfter=9, alignment=TA_LEFT, ), "cap": ParagraphStyle( "cap", fontName="Manrope-Semi", fontSize=8.8, leading=12.5, textColor=HexColor("#334155"), spaceBefore=0, spaceAfter=0, alignment=TA_CENTER, ), } def parse_copy(text: str) -> list[dict]: """Return sections of prose, figure, and row blocks.""" sections: list[dict] = [] current: dict | None = None prose: list[str] = [] lines = text.splitlines() index = 0 def flush() -> None: nonlocal prose if current is None: prose = [] return chunk = "\n".join(prose).strip() prose = [] if chunk: current["blocks"].append(("prose", chunk)) while index < len(lines): line = lines[index] stripped = line.strip() if stripped.startswith("## "): flush() current = {"title": stripped[3:].strip(), "blocks": []} sections.append(current) index += 1 continue if stripped == ":::figure": flush() if current is None: raise SystemExit("figure block before any section") index += 1 fields: dict[str, str] = {} while index < len(lines) and lines[index].strip() != ":::": raw = lines[index].strip() if ":" in raw: key, value = raw.split(":", 1) fields[key.strip()] = value.strip() index += 1 current["blocks"].append(("figure", fields)) index += 1 continue if stripped == ":::row": flush() if current is None: raise SystemExit("row block before any section") index += 1 items: list[dict[str, str]] = [] pending: dict[str, str] = {} while index < len(lines) and lines[index].strip() != ":::": raw = lines[index].strip() if raw.startswith("src:"): if pending.get("src") and pending.get("caption"): items.append(pending) pending = {"src": raw.split(":", 1)[1].strip()} elif raw.startswith("caption:"): pending["caption"] = raw.split(":", 1)[1].strip() index += 1 if pending.get("src") and pending.get("caption"): items.append(pending) current["blocks"].append(("row", items)) index += 1 continue if stripped.startswith("# "): index += 1 continue prose.append(line) index += 1 flush() return sections def prose_word_counts(sections: list[dict]) -> tuple[int, dict[str, int]]: per: dict[str, int] = {} total = 0 for section in sections: parts: list[str] = [] for block in section["blocks"]: if block[0] != "prose": continue for line in block[1].splitlines(): if line.strip().startswith("|"): continue parts.append(line) raw = "\n".join(parts) raw = re.sub(r"\[([^\]]+)\]\([^)]+\)", r"\1", raw) raw = raw.replace("**", "").replace("*", "").replace("`", "") words = raw.split() per[section["title"]] = len(words) total += len(words) return total, per def xml_text(text: str) -> str: text = text.replace("&", "&").replace("<", "<").replace(">", ">") def soften(match: re.Match[str]) -> str: url = match.group(0) punct = "" while url and url[-1] in ".,;:!?)": punct = url[-1] + punct url = url[:-1] plain = url.replace("&", "&") limit = 480 def wide(value: str) -> float: return pdfmetrics.stringWidth(value, "Manrope", 10.0) if wide(plain) <= limit: return f'{url}{punct}' pieces = url.split("/") lines: list[str] = [] current = pieces[0] for piece in pieces[1:]: addition = "/" + piece trial = (current + addition).replace("&", "&") if current and wide(trial) > limit: lines.append(current) current = addition else: current += addition if current: lines.append(current) display = "
".join(lines) return f'{display}{punct}' # Make raw URLs clickable hyperlinks text = re.sub(r"https?://[^\s<]+", soften, text) # Bold text text = re.sub(r"\*\*([^*]+)\*\*", r"\1", text) return text def body_paragraph(text: str, style: ParagraphStyle): xml = xml_text(text) kind = SolidParagraph if "http" in xml else Paragraph return kind(xml, style) def prepare_image(src: Path, dest: Path) -> tuple[int, int]: image = PILImage.open(src) if image.mode in ("RGBA", "LA") or (image.mode == "P" and "transparency" in image.info): image = image.convert("RGBA") base = PILImage.new("RGBA", image.size, (238, 242, 246, 255)) flat = PILImage.alpha_composite(base, image).convert("RGB") else: flat = image.convert("RGB") flat.save(dest, "PNG") return flat.size def create_recolored_wordmark(src: Path, dest: Path, rgb: tuple[int, int, int]) -> tuple[int, int]: """Extract smooth, anti-aliased STAMP wordmark recolored to rgb.""" img = PILImage.open(src).convert("RGBA") arr = np.array(img).astype(float) diff = np.sqrt( (arr[:, :, 0] - 226) ** 2 + (arr[:, :, 1] - 75) ** 2 + (arr[:, :, 2] - 255) ** 2 ) alpha = np.clip((diff - 20) / 60.0, 0, 1) out = np.zeros((img.height, img.width, 4), dtype=np.uint8) out[:, :, 0] = rgb[0] out[:, :, 1] = rgb[1] out[:, :, 2] = rgb[2] out[:, :, 3] = (alpha * 255).astype(np.uint8) res = PILImage.fromarray(out) bbox = res.getbbox() if bbox: pad = 20 box = ( max(0, bbox[0] - pad), max(0, bbox[1] - pad), min(img.width, bbox[2] + pad), min(img.height, bbox[3] + pad), ) cropped = res.crop(box) else: cropped = res cropped.save(dest, "PNG") return cropped.size # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- # FLOWABLES & PAGE LAYOUTS # --------------------------------------------------------------------------- class MinimalCover(Flowable): """Ultra-minimalist cover page strictly matching user specifications.""" def __init__(self, mark_path: str, px_w: int, px_h: int): super().__init__() self.mark_path = mark_path self.px_w = px_w self.px_h = px_h def wrap(self, avail_width, avail_height): self.avail_width = avail_width self.avail_height = avail_height return avail_width, avail_height def draw(self): canv = self.canv W = self.avail_width H = self.avail_height cx = W / 2 # Centered STAMP Wordmark mark_w = 400 mark_h = mark_w * self.px_h / self.px_w center_y = H / 2 mark_y = center_y + 10 mark_x = cx - mark_w / 2 canv.drawImage( self.mark_path, mark_x, mark_y, mark_w, mark_h, mask="auto", preserveAspectRatio=True, ) # Centered Tagline tag_y = mark_y - 36 canv.setFillColor(HexColor("#E24BFF")) canv.setFont("Manrope-Bold", 24) canv.drawCentredString(cx, tag_y, "PEEL. PRESS. TOAST.") # Bottom text in white canv.setFillColor(white) canv.setFont("Manrope-Semi", 14) canv.drawCentredString(cx, 48, "Commercial Business Plan") class CleanSectionPage(Flowable): """Dedicated full-bleed section divider page with wrapping primary title & subtitle.""" def __init__(self, title: str, subtitle: str, scheme: dict): super().__init__() self.scheme = scheme title_style = ParagraphStyle( f"sec_title_{scheme['id']}", fontName="Manrope-Bold", fontSize=32, leading=38, textColor=scheme["primary"], spaceBefore=0, spaceAfter=14, alignment=TA_LEFT, ) sub_style = ParagraphStyle( f"sec_sub_{scheme['id']}", fontName="Manrope-Semi", fontSize=15, leading=21, textColor=scheme["primary"], spaceBefore=0, spaceAfter=0, alignment=TA_LEFT, ) self.title_p = Paragraph(xml_text(title), title_style) self.sub_p = Paragraph(xml_text(subtitle), sub_style) if subtitle else None def wrap(self, avail_width, avail_height): self.avail_width = avail_width self.avail_height = avail_height _w1, self.t_h = self.title_p.wrap(avail_width, avail_height) self.s_h = 0 if self.sub_p: _w2, self.s_h = self.sub_p.wrap(avail_width, avail_height) return avail_width, avail_height def draw(self): canv = self.canv # Vertically align around 58% of available height total_h = self.t_h + (14 + self.s_h if self.sub_p else 0) y_top = (self.avail_height * 0.58) + total_h / 2 self.title_p.drawOn(canv, 0, y_top - - All external links (including competitor product links, podcast deep-dives, Griffiths Foods contact portals, the live Vercel web platform, and GitHub repository) are now **native PDF hyperlinks** formatted with clean brand styling (`#6D28D9` with underline). args.CodeContent:
"""Market figures for the Stamp commercial business plan.

Figures are branded strictly following Stamp's visual identity:
- Exact Manrope typography matching the document:
  - Manrope-Bold (700) for titles, data callouts, and key metrics
  - Manrope-Semi (600) for axis labels and category names
  - Manrope-Medium (500) for tick marks and legends
- Figure backgrounds match the document container color (#EEF2F6) exactly.
- High-contrast Stamp brand colors:
  Deep Night Ink (#240340), Deep Solid Purple (#3B0764), Electric Lavender (#E24BFF),
  Wild Raspberry (#FF467A), Roasted Peanut (#FF8C30), Electric Butter (#FFD640)
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

import matplotlib.font_manager as fm
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "figures"
DATA = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "sales-clean.csv"
FONT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent / "brand" / "fonts"

# Exact font properties matching the document typography
F_BOLD = fm.FontProperties(fname=str(FONT_DIR / "Manrope-700.ttf"))
F_SEMI = fm.FontProperties(fname=str(FONT_DIR / "Manrope-600.ttf"))
F_MED = fm.FontProperties(fname=str(FONT_DIR / "Manrope-500.ttf"))
F_REG = fm.FontProperties(fname=str(FONT_DIR / "Manrope-400.ttf"))

# Exact container background color matching PDF containers
CONTAINER_BG = "#EEF2F6"

CATEGORY_ORDER = [
    "Breakfast Cereals",
    "Nutritional Cereal Bars",
    "Spreads",
    "Liquid Breakfasts",
]

TIER_ORDER = ["Value", "Standard", "Premium"]

BRAND_COLOURS = {
    "Breakfast Cereals": "#3B0764",       # Deep Solid Purple
    "Nutritional Cereal Bars": "#FF8C30", # Peanut Ochre
    "Spreads": "#E24BFF",                 # Electric Lavender (highlighted)
    "Liquid Breakfasts": "#FF467A",       # Wild Raspberry
    "2022": "#3B0764",                    # Deep Solid Purple
    "2025": "#E24BFF",                    # Electric Lavender
}


def quarterly_revenue(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
    quarters = sorted(frame["Date"].unique())
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10.5, 5.2), dpi=200)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(CONTAINER_BG)
    ax.set_facecolor(CONTAINER_BG)

    for category in CATEGORY_ORDER:
        part = frame[frame["Category"] == category]
        series = (
            part.groupby("Date")["Revenue (Thousands NZD)"].sum().reindex(quarters).fillna(0)
            / 1000
        )
        is_spreads = category == "Spreads"
        ax.plot(
            quarters,
            series.values,
            label=f"{category} (Focus)" if is_spreads else category,
            color=BRAND_COLOURS[category],
            linewidth=3.2 if is_spreads else 1.8,
            alpha=1.0 if is_spreads else 0.75,
            zorder=5 if is_spreads else 3,
        )

    ax.set_title(
        "Quarterly Breakfast Category Revenue in New Zealand (2022–2025)",
        fontproperties=F_BOLD,
        fontsize=13.5,
        color="#240340",
        pad=16,
    )
    ax.set_ylabel("Revenue (Million NZD)", fontproperties=F_SEMI, fontsize=10.5, color="#475569", labelpad=10)
    ax.set_xlabel("Quarter", fontproperties=F_SEMI, fontsize=10.5, color="#475569", labelpad=10)

    legend = ax.legend(
        frameon=True,
        facecolor=CONTAINER_BG,
        edgecolor="#CBD5E1",
        loc="upper left",
    )
    for text in legend.get_texts():
        text.set_fontproperties(F_SEMI)
        text.set_fontsize(9.5)
        text.set_color("#1A1024")

    ax.tick_params(axis="x", labelrotation=45, colors="#475569")
    for label in ax.get_xticklabels():
        label.set_fontproperties(F_MED)
        label.set_fontsize(9.0)

    ax.tick_params(axis="y", colors="#64748B")
    for label in ax.get_yticklabels():
        label.set_fontproperties(F_MED)
        label.set_fontsize(9.5)

    ax.grid(axis="y", linestyle="--", alpha=0.5, color="#CBD5E1", zorder=0)
    ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines["left"].set_color("#CBD5E1")
    ax.spines["bottom"].set_color("#CBD5E1")

    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(OUT / "01-quarterly-revenue-by-category.png", dpi=200, facecolor=CONTAINER_BG)
    plt.close(fig)


def tier_comparison(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
    spreads = frame[frame["Category"] == "Spreads"].copy()
    spreads["year"] = spreads["Date"].str.slice(0, 4)
    part = spreads[spreads["year"].isin(["2022", "2025"])]
    totals = (
        part.groupby(["year", "Price Tier"])["Revenue (Thousands NZD)"].sum().unstack("year")
        / 1000
    )
    totals = totals.reindex(TIER_ORDER)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.5, 4.8), dpi=200)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(CONTAINER_BG)
    ax.set_facecolor(CONTAINER_BG)

    positions = np.arange(len(TIER_ORDER))
    width = 0.35

    rects1 = ax.bar(
        positions - width / 2,
        totals["2022"],
        width=width,
        label="2022 Revenue",
        color=BRAND_COLOURS["2022"],
        edgecolor="none",
        zorder=3,
    )
    rects2 = ax.bar(
        positions + width / 2,
        totals["2025"],
        width=width,
        label="2025 Revenue",
        color=BRAND_COLOURS["2025"],
        edgecolor="none",
        zorder=3,
    )

    # Direct value annotations above each bar using Manrope-Bold
    for rect in rects1:
        h = rect.get_height()
        ax.annotate(
            f"${h:.1f}M",
            (rect.get_x() + rect.get_width() / 2, h),
            xytext=(0, 5),
            textcoords="offset points",
            ha="center",
            va="bottom",
            fontproperties=F_BOLD,
            fontsize=9.5,
            color="#3B0764",
        )

    for rect in rects2:
        h = rect.get_height()
        ax.annotate(
            f"${h:.1f}M",
            (rect.get_x() + rect.get_width() / 2, h),
            xytext=(0, 5),
            textcoords="offset points",
            ha="center",
            va="bottom",
            fontproperties=F_BOLD,
            fontsize=9.5,
            color="#A21CAF",
        )

    ax.set_xticks(positions)
    ax.set_xticklabels(TIER_ORDER)
    for label in ax.get_xticklabels():
        label.set_fontproperties(F_BOLD)
        label.set_fontsize(11.0)
        label.set_color("#1A1024")

    ax.set_ylabel("Revenue (Million NZD)", fontproperties=F_SEMI, fontsize=10.5, color="#475569", labelpad=10)
    ax.set_title(
        "New Zealand Spreads Category Revenue by Price Tier (2022 vs 2025)",
        fontproperties=F_BOLD,
        fontsize=13.0,
        color="#240340",
        pad=16,
    )

    ax.grid(axis="y", linestyle="--", alpha=0.5, color="#CBD5E1", zorder=0)
    ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines["left"].set_color("#CBD5E1")
    ax.spines["bottom"].set_color("#CBD5E1")

    ax.tick_params(axis="y", colors="#64748B")
    for label in ax.get_yticklabels():
        label.set_fontproperties(F_MED)
        label.set_fontsize(9.5)

    ax.tick_params(axis="x", colors="#1A1024", length=0)
    ax.set_ylim(0, max(totals.max()) * 1.18)

    legend = ax.legend(
        frameon=True,
        facecolor=CONTAINER_BG,
        edgecolor="#CBD5E1",
        loc="upper left",
    )
    for text in legend.get_texts():
        text.set_fontproperties(F_SEMI)
        text.set_fontsize(9.5)
        text.set_color("#1A1024")

    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(OUT / "02-spreads-revenue-by-tier-2022-vs-2025.png", dpi=200, facecolor=CONTAINER_BG)
    plt.close(fig)


def price_distribution(frame: pd.DataFrame) -> None:
    spreads = frame[
        (frame["Category"] == "Spreads")
        & (frame["Market Segment"] == "Branded")
        & frame["price_usable"]
        & frame["price_per_100g"].notna()
    ].copy()

    sku = spreads.groupby(["Product Name", "Brand", "Weight"], as_index=False)[
        "price_per_100g"
    ].median()

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8.5, 4.8), dpi=200)
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(CONTAINER_BG)
    ax.set_facecolor(CONTAINER_BG)

    # Histogram with Stamp brand colors
    n, bins, patches = ax.hist(
        sku["price_per_100g"],
        bins=26,
        color="#240340",
        edgecolor=CONTAINER_BG,
        linewidth=1.2,
        zorder=3,
    )

    for patch in patches:
        if patch.get_x() >= 5.0:
            patch.set_facecolor("#3B0764")

    # Stamp price line
    stamp_price = 6.25
    ax.axvline(stamp_price, color="#E24BFF", linestyle="-", linewidth=2.6, zorder=4)

    # 90th percentile benchmark line
    p90 = sku["price_per_100g"].quantile(0.9)
    ax.axvline(p90, color="#FF8C30", linestyle="--", linewidth=1.8, zorder=4)

    # Annotations in Manrope
    ylim = ax.get_ylim()[1]
    ax.text(
        stamp_price + 0.15,
        ylim * 0.88,
        "STAMP: $6.25 / 100 g\nFormat Innovation Premium",
        fontproperties=F_BOLD,
        fontsize=9.5,
        color="#A21CAF",
        va="top",
    )

    ax.text(
        p90 - 0.15,
        ylim * 0.72,
        f"90th Percentile: ${p90:.2f} / 100 g",
        fontproperties=F_SEMI,
        fontsize=8.5,
        color="#C2410C",
        ha="right",
        va="top",
    )

    ax.set_xlabel("Shelf Price per 100 g (NZD)", fontproperties=F_SEMI, fontsize=10.5, color="#475569", labelpad=8)
    ax.set_ylabel("Number of Branded Spread SKUs", fontproperties=F_SEMI, fontsize=10.5, color="#475569", labelpad=8)
    ax.set_title(
        "Shelf Price Distribution Across 154 Branded New Zealand Spread SKUs",
        fontproperties=F_BOLD,
        fontsize=13.0,
        color="#240340",
        pad=16,
    )

    ax.grid(axis="y", linestyle="--", alpha=0.5, color="#CBD5E1", zorder=0)
    ax.spines["top"].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines["right"].set_visible(False)
    ax.spines["left"].set_color("#CBD5E1")
    ax.spines["bottom"].set_color("#CBD5E1")

    ax.tick_params(axis="y", colors="#64748B")
    for label in ax.get_yticklabels():
        label.set_fontproperties(F_MED)
        label.set_fontsize(9.5)

    ax.tick_params(axis="x", colors="#1A1024")
    for label in ax.get_xticklabels():
        label.set_fontproperties(F_MED)
        label.set_fontsize(9.5)

    fig.tight_layout()
    fig.savefig(OUT / "03-branded-spreads-price-per-100g.png", dpi=200, facecolor=CONTAINER_BG)
    plt.close(fig)

    quantiles = sku["price_per_100g"].quantile([0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9])
    print("branded spread SKUs", len(sku))
    print(quantiles.to_string())
    print("min", round(sku["price_per_100g"].min(), 2), "max", round(sku["price_per_100g"].max(), 2))


def main() -> None:
    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    frame = pd.read_csv(DATA)
    quarterly_revenue(frame)
    tier_comparison(frame)
    price_distribution(frame)
    print("Successfully regenerated branded figures with matching container background and Manrope typography")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

class CleanImageRow(Flowable):
    """Bold elevated row of images on white canvas."""

    def __init__(self, items: list[tuple[str, str]], max_height: float, scheme: dict):
        super().__init__()
        self.items = items
        self.max_height = max_height
        self.scheme = scheme
        self.sizes = []
        for p, _c in items:
            with PILImage.open(p) as img:
                self.sizes.append(img.size)

    def wrap(self, avail_width, avail_height):
        count = len(self.items)
        gap = 14
        col_w = (avail_width - gap * (count - 1)) / count
        pad = 12
        inner_w = col_w - 2 * pad
        inner_max_h = self.max_height - 42
        self.cols = []
        row_h = 0
        cap_style = ParagraphStyle(
            f"row_cap_{self.scheme['id']}",
            fontName="Manrope-Semi",
            fontSize=8.2,
            leading=11.5,
            textColor=HexColor("#334155"),
            alignment=TA_CENTER,
        )

        for (path, caption), (px_w, px_h) in zip(self.items, self.sizes):
            scale = min(inner_w / px_w, inner_max_h / px_h)
            draw_w = px_w * scale
            draw_h = px_h * scale
            paragraph = Paragraph(xml_text(caption), cap_style)
            _cw, cap_h = paragraph.wrap(col_w - 16, 800)
            card_h = draw_h + pad + 16 + cap_h + 6
            row_h = max(row_h, card_h)
            self.cols.append((path, draw_w, draw_h, paragraph, cap_h, col_w, card_h))

        self.gap = gap
        self.avail_width = avail_width
        self.row_h = row_h
        return avail_width, row_h

    def draw(self):
        canv = self.canv
        x = 0
        r = 12
        for path, draw_w, draw_h, paragraph, cap_h, col_w, card_h in self.cols:
            cy = self.row_h - card_h
            canv.saveState()
            # 1. Clean elevated card surface
            canv.setFillColor(HexColor("#EEF2F6"))
            canv.roundRect(x, cy, col_w, card_h, r, stroke=0, fill=1)

            # 2. Image
            img_x = x + (col_w - draw_w) / 2
            img_y = cy + cap_h + 12
            canv.drawImage(
                path,
                img_x,
                img_y,
                draw_w,
                draw_h,
                mask="auto",
                preserveAspectRatio=True,
            )

            paragraph.drawOn(canv, x + 8, cy + 8)
            canv.restoreState()
            x += col_w + self.gap

def prepare_image(src: Path, dest: Path) -> tuple[int, int]:
    image = PILImage.open(src)
    if image.mode in ("RGBA", "LA") or (image.mode == "P" and "transparency" in image.info):
        image = image.convert("RGBA")
        base = PILImage.new("RGBA", image.size, (238, 242, 246, 255))
        flat = PILImage.alpha_composite(base, image).convert("RGB")
    else:
        flat = image.convert("RGB")
        # For diagrams with white background, blend seamlessly into container color #EEF2F6
        arr = np.array(flat)
        mask = (arr[:, :, 0] > 245) & (arr[:, :, 1] > 245) & (arr[:, :, 2] > 245)
        if mask.any():
            arr[mask] = [238, 242, 246]
            flat = PILImage.fromarray(arr)
    flat.save(dest, "PNG")
    return flat.size

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate presentation/Stamp-pitch.pptx for INFO123 Video Presentation.

Strictly adheres to the Stamp web design system:
- 16:9 widescreen layout (13.333" x 7.5")
- Deep Night Ink (#240340) full-bleed canvas across all slides
- Flat, borderless, shadowless elevated cards in Deep Solid Purple (#3B0764)
- Saturated, high-contrast primary accents everywhere:
  - Electric Lavender (#E24BFF)
  - Butter Gold (#FFD640)
  - Wild Raspberry (#FF467A)
  - Peanut Ochre (#FF8C30)
- High-legibility typography: Pure White (#FFFFFF) headlines, Soft Lavender (#E9D5FF) body
- High-impact stat callouts and structured cue cards for talking-head video presentation
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path
import pptx
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN, MSO_ANCHOR
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
OUT_PPTX = ROOT / "presentation" / "Stamp-pitch.pptx"

# Authentic Brand Palette from website/src/lib/theme.svelte.ts
BG_NIGHT_INK = RGBColor(36, 3, 64)       # #240340 (Canvas background)
SURFACE_PURPLE = RGBColor(59, 7, 100)    # #3B0764 (Flat solid card surface)
SURFACE_ELEVATED = RGBColor(76, 12, 128) # #4C0C80 (Elevated container)

ACCENT_LAVENDER = RGBColor(226, 75, 255) # #E24BFF (Electric Lavender)
ACCENT_BUTTER = RGBColor(255, 214, 64)   # #FFD640 (Electric Butter Gold)
ACCENT_BERRY = RGBColor(255, 70, 122)    # #FF467A (Wild Raspberry)
ACCENT_PEANUT = RGBColor(255, 140, 48)   # #FF8C30 (Roasted Peanut Ochre)

TEXT_WHITE = RGBColor(255, 255, 255)     # #FFFFFF (Headlines & primary text)
TEXT_SOFT = RGBColor(233, 213, 255)      # #E9D5FF (Body & bullet points)
TEXT_MUTED = RGBColor(216, 180, 254)     # #D8B4FE (Subtitles & metadata)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SLIDE TEMPLATE HELPERS (Zero borders, zero shadows, flat solid surfaces)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def create_base_slide(prs: pptx.Presentation):
    """Create a new slide with a full-bleed Deep Night Ink (#240340) background."""
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
    bg = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, 0, 0, prs.slide_width, prs.slide_height)
    bg.fill.solid()
    bg.fill.fore_color.rgb = BG_NIGHT_INK
    bg.line.fill.background()
    return slide


def add_flat_card(
    slide,
    left: Inches,
    top: Inches,
    width: Inches,
    height: Inches,
    bg_color: RGBColor = SURFACE_PURPLE,
    shape_type = MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE,
):
    """Add a borderless, shadowless flat solid card."""
    card = slide.shapes.add_shape(shape_type, left, top, width, height)
    card.fill.solid()
    card.fill.fore_color.rgb = bg_color
    card.line.fill.background()
    return card


def add_kicker_badge(
    slide,
    left: Inches,
    top: Inches,
    text: str,
    text_color: RGBColor = ACCENT_LAVENDER,
    bg_color: RGBColor = SURFACE_PURPLE,
    width: Inches | None = None,
):
    """Add a clean flat solid pill badge for section kickers and timers."""
    est_width = width if width is not None else Inches(max(len(text) * 0.11 + 0.4, 1.8))
    badge = slide.shapes.add_shape(
        MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, left, top, est_width, Inches(0.36)
    )
    badge.fill.solid()
    badge.fill.fore_color.rgb = bg_color
    badge.line.fill.background()

    tf = badge.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = False
    tf.margin_left = Inches(0.15)
    tf.margin_right = Inches(0.15)
    tf.margin_top = Inches(0.05)
    tf.margin_bottom = Inches(0.05)

    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = text.upper()
    p.font.name = "Manrope"
    p.font.size = Pt(10.5)
    p.font.bold = True
    p.font.color.rgb = text_color
    p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
    return badge


def add_slide_header(
    slide,
    kicker: str,
    title: str,
    subtitle: str,
    kicker_color: RGBColor = ACCENT_LAVENDER,
):
    """Standardized top header zone matching the web brand."""
    left = Inches(0.8)
    top = Inches(0.5)

    # 1. Kicker Pill Badge
    add_kicker_badge(slide, left, top, kicker, text_color=kicker_color)

    # 2. Header Textbox (Title + Subtitle)
    tb = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top + Inches(0.44), Inches(11.7), Inches(1.05))
    tf = tb.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    tf.margin_left = tf.margin_top = tf.margin_right = tf.margin_bottom = 0

    p_title = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p_title.text = title
    p_title.font.name = "Manrope"
    p_title.font.size = Pt(26)
    p_title.font.bold = True
    p_title.font.color.rgb = TEXT_WHITE
    p_title.space_after = Pt(2)

    p_sub = tf.add_paragraph()
    p_sub.text = subtitle
    p_sub.font.name = "Manrope"
    p_sub.font.size = Pt(13)
    p_sub.font.color.rgb = TEXT_MUTED


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SLIDE BUILDERS
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def build_slide_1_hero(prs: pptx.Presentation):
    """Slide 1: Hero Title Slide (Ultra-Bold, Clean, Iconic)."""
    slide = create_base_slide(prs)

    # Left content column
    left_x = Inches(0.9)

    # 1. Kicker Badge
    add_kicker_badge(slide, left_x, Inches(1.2), "COMMERCIAL PROPOSAL • INFO123 PROJECT", ACCENT_LAVENDER)

    # 2. Title & Tagline Textbox
    tb_title = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left_x, Inches(1.75), Inches(7.5), Inches(2.8))
    tf = tb_title.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    tf.margin_left = tf.margin_top = tf.margin_right = tf.margin_bottom = 0

    p_brand = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p_brand.text = "STAMP"
    p_brand.font.name = "Manrope"
    p_brand.font.size = Pt(64)
    p_brand.font.bold = True
    p_brand.font.color.rgb = ACCENT_LAVENDER
    p_brand.space_after = Pt(2)

    p_tag = tf.add_paragraph()
    p_tag.text = "PEEL. PRESS. TOAST."
    p_tag.font.name = "Manrope"
    p_tag.font.size = Pt(26)
    p_tag.font.bold = True
    p_tag.font.color.rgb = TEXT_WHITE
    p_tag.space_after = Pt(10)

    p_lead = tf.add_paragraph()
    p_lead.text = "The Single-Serve Breakfast Spread Discs for Hot Toast"
    p_lead.font.name = "Manrope"
    p_lead.font.size = Pt(16)
    p_lead.font.color.rgb = TEXT_MUTED

    # 3. Three Hero Pills
    badges_y = Inches(4.7)
    badges = [
        ("$5.00 NZD / Sheet", ACCENT_LAVENDER),
        ("12-Month Pantry Stable", ACCENT_BUTTER),
        ("No Jar Waste • Utensil-Free", ACCENT_BERRY),
    ]
    bx = left_x
    for label, col in badges:
        bw = Inches(len(label) * 0.11 + 0.5)
        add_kicker_badge(slide, bx, badges_y, label, text_color=col, width=bw)
        bx += bw + Inches(0.25)

    # 4. Presenter Info Card (Flat Solid Surface)
    card_pres = add_flat_card(slide, left_x, Inches(5.4), Inches(7.2), Inches(1.3))
    tb_pres = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left_x + Inches(0.3), Inches(5.55), Inches(6.6), Inches(1.0))
    tf_p = tb_pres.text_frame
    tf_p.word_wrap = True
    tf_p.margin_left = tf_p.margin_top = tf_p.margin_right = tf_p.margin_bottom = 0

    row1 = tf_p.paragraphs[0]
    row1.text = "PRESENTER: "
    row1.font.name = "Manrope"
    row1.font.size = Pt(12)
    row1.font.bold = True
    row1.font.color.rgb = ACCENT_LAVENDER
    run1 = row1.add_run()
    run1.text = "Jacob  |  INFO123 Business AI Project"
    run1.font.bold = True
    run1.font.color.rgb = TEXT_WHITE
    row1.space_after = Pt(4)

    row2 = tf_p.add_paragraph()
    row2.text = "LIVE PLATFORM: "
    row2.font.name = "Manrope"
    row2.font.size = Pt(11)
    row2.font.bold = True
    row2.font.color.rgb = ACCENT_BUTTER
    run2 = row2.add_run()
    run2.text = "stamp-spreads.vercel.app  •  github.com/JacobCrume/stamp-spreads"
    run2.font.bold = False
    run2.font.color.rgb = TEXT_SOFT

    # 5. Right Hero Image (Butter Pack Shot or Logo)
    pack_path = ROOT / "brand" / "explorations" / "flavours" / "butter.png"
    if not pack_path.exists():
        pack_path = ROOT / "brand" / "pack.png"
    if pack_path.exists():
        slide.shapes.add_picture(str(pack_path), Inches(8.7), Inches(1.5), width=Inches(3.8))

    # Speaker Notes
    slide.notes_slide.notes_text_frame.text = (
        "TITLE SLIDE (0:00–0:08)\n"
        "Kia ora. I'm Jacob, and this is Stamp: a New Zealand breakfast spread innovation "
        "engineered for hot toast. Over the next minute, I will present our product and "
        "market opportunity, followed by my personal reflection on building with generative AI."
    )


def build_slide_2_pitch1(prs: pptx.Presentation):
    """Slide 2: Pitch 1 — Product Innovation & Launch Range (0:08–0:34)."""
    slide = create_base_slide(prs)

    add_slide_header(
        slide,
        kicker="INVESTOR PITCH • PART 1 (30 SECONDS)",
        title="Product Innovation: Peel. Press. Toast.",
        subtitle="A calibrated 10 g disc on release film: no knife, no sticky jar, no morning wash-up.",
        kicker_color=ACCENT_LAVENDER,
    )

    card_y = Inches(2.0)
    card_h = Inches(4.9)

    # ------------------
    # LEFT CARD: The Problem & The Format Gesture
    # ------------------
    card_w1 = Inches(5.7)
    add_flat_card(slide, Inches(0.8), card_y, card_w1, card_h)

    tb_l = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(1.15), card_y + Inches(0.35), Inches(5.0), card_h - Inches(0.7))
    tf_l = tb_l.text_frame
    tf_l.word_wrap = True
    tf_l.margin_left = tf_l.margin_top = tf_l.margin_right = tf_l.margin_bottom = 0

    p_title = tf_l.paragraphs[0]
    p_title.text = "The Out-of-Kitchen Friction"
    p_title.font.name = "Manrope"
    p_title.font.size = Pt(18)
    p_title.font.bold = True
    p_title.font.color.rgb = ACCENT_LAVENDER
    p_title.space_after = Pt(14)

    left_points = [
        ("The Jar Infrastructure Problem",
         "Eating toast away from home (office breakrooms, student halls, flat kitchens) demands cutlery, a sticky tub, and a sink to wash up. Cutlery-dependent spreads fail mobile consumers."),
        ("The Peel-and-Press Format",
         "Each Stamp delivers a calibrated 10 g disc mounted onto food-grade release film. Peel the disc, press it directly onto hot bread, and residual heat softens it into an even, velvety layer across the crumb."),
        ("12-Month Ambient Pantry Life",
         "Proprietary water-activity barrier formulation packaged in airtight card sheets provides verified 12-month ambient shelf stability without refrigeration."),
    ]

    for title, desc in left_points:
        p_pt = tf_l.add_paragraph()
        p_pt.text = "• " + title + "\n"
        p_pt.font.name = "Manrope"
        p_pt.font.size = Pt(12)
        p_pt.font.bold = True
        p_pt.font.color.rgb = TEXT_WHITE
        p_pt.space_after = Pt(3)

        run_desc = p_pt.add_run()
        run_desc.text = desc
        run_desc.font.name = "Manrope"
        run_desc.font.size = Pt(11)
        run_desc.font.bold = False
        run_desc.font.color.rgb = TEXT_SOFT
        p_pt.space_after = Pt(10)

    # ------------------
    # RIGHT CARD: Four Launch Flavours
    # ------------------
    card_x2 = Inches(6.8)
    card_w2 = Inches(5.7)
    add_flat_card(slide, card_x2, card_y, card_w2, card_h)

    tb_r = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(7.15), card_y + Inches(0.35), Inches(5.0), Inches(0.5))
    tf_r = tb_r.text_frame
    tf_r.word_wrap = True
    tf_r.margin_left = tf_r.margin_top = tf_r.margin_right = tf_r.margin_bottom = 0

    p_rt = tf_r.paragraphs[0]
    p_rt.text = "Four Launch Flavours"
    p_rt.font.name = "Manrope"
    p_rt.font.size = Pt(18)
    p_rt.font.bold = True
    p_rt.font.color.rgb = ACCENT_BUTTER

    flavours = [
        ("Salted Butter", "Cultured dairy spread (2 g salt / 78 g fat). Rich European style.", ACCENT_BUTTER),
        ("Wild Raspberry", "150 g fruit paste / 100 g. Natural pectin set, tart & vibrant.", ACCENT_BERRY),
        ("Yeast Extract", "80% autolysed yeast, 15.5% barley malt. Classic savoury umami.", ACCENT_LAVENDER),
        ("Roasted Peanut", "96% roasted peanuts + hard fat anti-oil separation barrier.", ACCENT_PEANUT),
    ]

    fy = card_y + Inches(0.9)
    for name, desc, col in flavours:
        fl_card = add_flat_card(slide, Inches(7.1), fy, Inches(5.1), Inches(0.68), bg_color=SURFACE_ELEVATED)
        tb_f = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(7.25), fy + Inches(0.08), Inches(4.8), Inches(0.55))
        tf_f = tb_f.text_frame
        tf_f.word_wrap = True
        tf_f.margin_left = tf_f.margin_top = tf_f.margin_right = tf_f.margin_bottom = 0

        p1 = tf_f.paragraphs[0]
        p1.text = name.upper() + "  "
        p1.font.name = "Manrope"
        p1.font.size = Pt(11)
        p1.font.bold = True
        p1.font.color.rgb = col

        p2 = tf_f.add_paragraph()
        p2.text = desc
        p2.font.name = "Manrope"
        p2.font.size = Pt(9.5)
        p2.font.color.rgb = TEXT_SOFT
        fy += Inches(0.78)

    # Packaging shot below the flavours
    pack_path = ROOT / "brand" / "pack.png"
    if pack_path.exists():
        slide.shapes.add_picture(str(pack_path), Inches(8.3), Inches(5.4), height=Inches(1.4))

    # Speaker Notes
    slide.notes_slide.notes_text_frame.text = (
        "PITCH SLIDE 1 (0:08–0:34)\n"
        "Eating toast away from a full kitchen is broken. When you're in a student hall, flat, "
        "or office desk, nobody wants to lug a sticky 750-gram jar, track down a table knife, "
        "and wash it in an office sink.\n\n"
        "Stamp reinvents the format with a thin, 10-gram disc of real spread on release film. "
        "You peel it off, press it onto hot toast, and residual heat softens it into an even spread "
        "in seconds. No knife, no open jar, no morning mess.\n\n"
        "We launch with four distinct flavours: Salted Butter, Raspberry, Yeast extract, and Peanut—"
        "pantry-stable for 12 months in an 8-stamp card sheet."
    )


def build_slide_3_pitch2(prs: pptx.Presentation):
    """Slide 3: Pitch 2 — Market Opportunity & Unit Economics (0:34–0:58)."""
    slide = create_base_slide(prs)

    add_slide_header(
        slide,
        kicker="INVESTOR PITCH • PART 2 (30 SECONDS)",
        title="Market Opportunity & Unit Economics",
        subtitle="$341M New Zealand category, 24% revenue growth, and zero portion-format rivals.",
        kicker_color=ACCENT_BERRY,
    )

    # ------------------
    # TOP ROW: 3 Bold Stat Callouts
    # ------------------
    top_y = Inches(2.0)
    stat_h = Inches(1.25)
    stat_w = Inches(3.7)
    gap = Inches(0.3)
    sx = Inches(0.8)

    stats = [
        ("$341M", "Total NZ Spreads Category", "+24% growth from $275M (2022–2025)", ACCENT_LAVENDER),
        ("+29%", "Premium Tier Surge", "Surging from $88M to $113M NZD", ACCENT_BERRY),
        ("0", "Format Innovation Rivals", "154 existing products; zero peel-and-press", ACCENT_BUTTER),
    ]

    for num, headline, detail, col in stats:
        add_flat_card(slide, sx, top_y, stat_w, stat_h)
        tb_s = slide.shapes.add_textbox(sx + Inches(0.2), top_y + Inches(0.12), stat_w - Inches(0.4), stat_h - Inches(0.24))
        tf_s = tb_s.text_frame
        tf_s.word_wrap = True
        tf_s.margin_left = tf_s.margin_top = tf_s.margin_right = tf_s.margin_bottom = 0

        p_num = tf_s.paragraphs[0]
        p_num.text = num
        p_num.font.name = "Manrope"
        p_num.font.size = Pt(28)
        p_num.font.bold = True
        p_num.font.color.rgb = col
        p_num.space_after = Pt(2)

        p_h = tf_s.add_paragraph()
        p_h.text = headline.upper()
        p_h.font.name = "Manrope"
        p_h.font.size = Pt(10)
        p_h.font.bold = True
        p_h.font.color.rgb = TEXT_WHITE
        p_h.space_after = Pt(1)

        p_d = tf_s.add_paragraph()
        p_d.text = detail
        p_d.font.name = "Manrope"
        p_d.font.size = Pt(9.5)
        p_d.font.color.rgb = TEXT_MUTED

        sx += stat_w + gap

    # ------------------
    # BOTTOM ROW: 2 Split Cards (Economics & Chart)
    # ------------------
    bot_y = Inches(3.45)
    bot_h = Inches(3.45)

    # Left: Commercial Model & Margins
    add_flat_card(slide, Inches(0.8), bot_y, Inches(5.7), bot_h)

    tb_m = slide.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(1.15), bot_y + Inches(0.25), Inches(5.0), bot_h - Inches(0.5))
    tf_m = tb_m.text_frame
    tf_m.word_wrap = True
    tf_m.margin_left = tf_m.margin_top = tf_m.margin_right = tf_m.margin_bottom = 0

    p_mt = tf_m.paragraphs[0]
    p_mt.text = "Commercial Model & Margins"
    p_mt.font.name = "Manrope"
    p_mt.font.size = Pt(17)
    p_mt.font.bold = True
    p_mt.font.color.rgb = ACCENT_LAVENDER
    p_mt.space_after = Pt(8)

    econ_points = [
        ("Retail Pricing", "$5.00 NZD per 80 g sheet (8 stamps = 63¢ per toast portion). Highly accessible impulse price point for students and commuters."),
        ("Format Innovation Premium", "$6.25 NZD per 100 g. Commands a premium above the category's 90th percentile ($5.19/100g) because consumers buy convenience, not bulk volume."),
        ("Strong Unit Economics", "At an assumed $1.50 contract manufacturing benchmark and 35% supermarket margin, Stamp retains a healthy $1.75 gross contribution per sheet."),
    ]

    for title, desc in econ_points:

# Stamp Video Presentation — Slide Redesign & Template

The slide deck has been redesigned from the ground up to match the Stamp web platform.

### Design System & Template Rules
1. **Geometry & Canvas**:
   - 16:9 Widescreen layout (`13.333" x 7.5"`).
   - Full-bleed **Deep Night Ink (`#240340`)** canvas across all slides.
2. **Zero Shadows & Flat Look**:
   - `line.fill.background()` and `shadow.inherit = False` on every element.
   - Clean solid surfaces (**Deep Solid Purple `#3B0764`**) with zero thin outlines.
3. **Bright, Bold Colors Everywhere**:
   - **Electric Lavender (`#E24BFF`)**: Hero wordmark, primary titles, and stat callouts.
   - **Butter Gold (`#FFD640`)**: Kicker badges, warning callouts, and salted butter accents.
   - **Wild Raspberry (`#FF467A`)**: Growth surge metrics and fruit paste cards.
   - **Roasted Peanut (`#FF8C30`)**: Peanut spread variety cards and knowledge-worker ethics accents.
4. **Typography**:
   - Pure White (`#FFFFFF`) bold headlines for contrast.
   - Soft Lavender (`#E9D5FF` / `#D8B4FE`) body text for readability on dark surfaces.

---

     1 Primary (accent/highlights), plus Neutral White (#FFFFFF) for text.
   - Absolutely NO other colors mixed on the same slide.
2. Distinct Flavour Color Schemes across sections:
   - Slide 1: Yeast / Classic (Deep Night Ink #240340, Solid Purple #3B0764, Electric Lavender #E24BFF)
   - Slide 2: Butter (Caramel #4A3000, Deep Umber #2D1D00, Butter Gold #FFD640)

   - Slide 5: Yeast / Outro (Deep Night Ink #240340, Solid Purple #3B0764, Electric Lavender #E24BFF)
3. Ruthlessly Decluttered:
   - Huge, confident typography (titles 32–44pt, numbers 44–54pt).
   - Maximum 2–3 brief bullet points per card (3–6 words each).
   - Generous breathing space, flat solid surfaces, zero shadows, zero borders.

# TEMPLATE PRIMITIVES (Strictly flat, shadowless, borderless)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def create_slide_canvas(prs: pptx.Presentation, bg_color: RGBColor):
    """Full-bleed flat canvas without borders or shadows."""
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
    bg = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, 0, 0, prs.slide_width, prs.slide_height)
    bg.fill.solid()
    bg.fill.fore_color.rgb = bg_color
    bg.line.fill.background()
    return slide


def add_flat_card(slide, left: Inches, top: Inches, width: Inches, height: Inches, fill_color: RGBColor):
    """Flat solid card surface."""
    card = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height)
    card.fill.solid()
    card.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    card.line.fill.background()
    return card


def add_kicker(slide, left: Inches, top: Inches, text: str, primary_color: RGBColor):
    """Minimal, bold kicker headline without borders."""
    tb = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, Inches(10), Inches(0.4))
    tf = tb.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = False
    tf.margin_left = tf.margin_top = tf.margin_right = tf.margin_bottom = 0
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = text.upper()
    p.font.name = "Manrope"
    p.font.size = Pt(12)
    p.font.bold = True
    p.font.color.rgb = primary_color
    return tb


def add_header(slide, left: Inches, top: Inches, kicker: str, title: str, subtitle: str, scheme: dict):
    """Decluttered standardized header zone."""
    add_kicker(slide, left, top, kicker, scheme["primary"])

    tb = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top + Inches(0.32), Inches(11.7), Inches(1.1))
    tf = tb.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    tf.margin_left = tf.margin_top = tf.margin_right = tf.margin_bottom = 0

    p_title = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p_title.text = title
    p_title.font.name = "Manrope"
    p_title.font.size = Pt(32)
    p_title.font.bold = True
    p_title.font.color.rgb = scheme["white"]
    p_title.space_after = Pt(2)

    p_sub = tf.add_paragraph()
    p_sub.text = subtitle
    p_sub.font.name = "Manrope"
    p_sub.font.size = Pt(14)
    p_sub.font.bold = False
    p_sub.font.color.rgb = scheme["primary"]

        "1. Explain how you actively stripped out generic corporate jargon in favour of plain, punchy facts.\n"
        "2. Emphasize the legal hazards of AI in food and beverage: hallucinated health benefits, "
        "false gluten-free claims, and allergen responsibility.\n"
        "3. Conclude with your takeaway: Generative AI accelerates drafting, but human judgment, taste, "
        "and ultimate accountability can never be outsourced to a model."
    )


def main():

Examining the `create_recolored_wordmark` function, the process involves opening an image, converting it to RGBA, and converting to a NumPy array for pixel manipulation. The code calculates a color difference from a specific RGB value and generates an alpha channel based on that difference. This suggests a recoloring operation where pixels similar to the target color are made transparent, allowing the new color to show through.


The provided code snippet focuses on generating a cropped, transparent PNG image with anti-aliasing. It calculates a bounding box to determine the cropping area, adding padding around the image. It handles the case where no bounding box is found, preventing errors.  The function saves the resulting cropped image in PNG format.


The core problem is the infrastructure needed for jarred spreads, specifically the dependence on cutlery and the stationary nature of the packaging. The solution involves a "peel and press" format: a spread disc on a release film. This format leverages the heat of toast to melt the spread, eliminating the need for knives and offering portion control.
   The proposed format also boasts a 12-month ambient shelf life achieved through a water-activity barrier. The product will be presented in pocketable card sheets.


Analyzing market data shows a $341M New Zealand spreads category with 24% growth, including a premium tier surging at 29%. Observing the competitive landscape, there are zero competitors offering a single-serve, utensil-free format across 154 supermarket spreads, indicating a significant format innovation opportunity. The unit economics suggest a strong $1.75 margin per sheet, based on a $5.00 NZD price and a $1.50 co-packing cost.


Strict constraints were applied to prevent AI-generated health claims and manage context drift across data processing stages, ensuring ethical and accurate information. The initial model assumed unrealistic ambient stability for butter, necessitating a shift to a cultured dairy spread to achieve the target shelf life after human verification. Price anomalies and formula errors were manually detected in retail scan data, emphasizing the need for independent auditing and validation of market pricing.


To ensure authenticity, I actively avoided generic AI buzzwords and focused on concrete product specifications derived from packaging data.  Strict compliance with food regulations, especially FSANZ standards, is mandatory, as is clear allergen labeling. The responsibility for information accuracy and ethical considerations remains human, regardless of any algorithmic assistance.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate presentation/Stamp-pitch.pptx for INFO123 Video Presentation.

Strictly adheres to:
1. Cover Slide: Almost identical to PDF Page 1 (Minimalist Deep Night Ink,
   centered STAMP wordmark, PEEL. PRESS. TOAST., and Commercial Business Pitch at the bottom).
2. Bite-sized, Single-Idea Slides:
   - One slide dedicated to each specific problem, solution, or insight.
   - Rapid-fire, dynamic presentation (~10-15s per slide) instead of text-dense walls.
3. The 3 Colors Plus Neutral Rule:
   - Each section uses ONLY: 1 Secondary (screen bg), 1 Tertiary (card surface),
     1 Primary (kicker, numbers, highlights), plus Neutral White (#FFFFFF).
   - Zero other colors mixed on the same slide.
4. Flavour Palette Grouping across related sections:
   - Cover & Outro: Yeast / Classic (#240340, #3B0764, #E24BFF, #FFFFFF)
   - Product Innovation: Butter (#4A3000, #2D1D00, #FFD640, #FFFFFF)
   - Market & Economics: Raspberry (#460820, #2D0414, #FF467A, #FFFFFF)
   - Reflection (Steering & Verification): Peanut (#4E2408, #2D1403, #FF8C30, #FFFFFF)
   - Reflection (Slop & Ethics): Yeast / Classic (#240340, #3B0764, #E24BFF, #FFFFFF)
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image as PILImage
import pptx
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt
from pptx.enum.text import PP_ALIGN
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.shapes import MSO_SHAPE

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
OUT_PPTX = ROOT / "presentation" / "Stamp-pitch.pptx"

# 4 Flavour Color Schemes strictly honoring the 3 colors + neutral rule
SCHEMES = {
    "yeast": {
        "secondary": RGBColor(36, 3, 64),    # #240340 (Deep Night Ink)
        "tertiary": RGBColor(59, 7, 100),    # #3B0764 (Deep Solid Purple)
        "primary": RGBColor(226, 75, 255),   # #E24BFF (Electric Lavender)
        "white": RGBColor(255, 255, 255),
        "rgb": (226, 75, 255),
    },
    "butter": {
        "secondary": RGBColor(74, 48, 0),    # #4A3000 (Roasted Caramel Brown)
        "tertiary": RGBColor(45, 29, 0),     # #2D1D00 (Deep Umber)
        "primary": RGBColor(255, 214, 64),   # #FFD640 (Electric Butter Gold)
        "white": RGBColor(255, 255, 255),
        "rgb": (255, 214, 64),
    },
    "raspberry": {
        "secondary": RGBColor(70, 8, 32),    # #460820 (Rich Berry)
        "tertiary": RGBColor(45, 4, 20),     # #2D0414 (Dark Berry Maroon)
        "primary": RGBColor(255, 70, 122),   # #FF467A (Neon Wild Raspberry)
        "white": RGBColor(255, 255, 255),
        "rgb": (255, 70, 122),
    },
    "peanut": {
        "secondary": RGBColor(78, 36, 8),    # #4E2408 (Deep Peanut Umber)
        "tertiary": RGBColor(45, 20, 3),     # #2D1403 (Dark Roasted Nut Brown)
        "primary": RGBColor(255, 140, 48),   # #FF8C30 (Roasted Peanut Ochre)
        "white": RGBColor(255, 255, 255),
        "rgb": (255, 140, 48),
    },
}


def create_recolored_wordmark(src: Path, dest: Path, rgb: tuple[int, int, int]) -> tuple[int, int]:
    """Extract smooth, anti-aliased STAMP wordmark recolored to rgb."""
    img = PILImage.open(src).convert("RGBA")
    arr = np.array(img).astype(float)
    diff = np.sqrt(
        (arr[:, :, 0] - 226) ** 2
        + (arr[:, :, 1] - 75) ** 2
        + (arr[:, :, 2] - 255) ** 2
    )
    alpha = np.clip((diff - 20) / 60.0, 0, 1)
    out = np.zeros((img.height, img.width, 4), dtype=np.uint8)
    out[:, :, 0] = rgb[0]
    out[:, :, 1] = rgb[1]
    out[:, :, 2] = rgb[2]
    out[:, :, 3] = (alpha * 255).astype(np.uint8)
    res = PILImage.fromarray(out)
    bbox = res.getbbox()
    if bbox:
        pad = 20
        box = (
            max(0, bbox[0] - pad),
            max(0, bbox[1] - pad),
            min(img.width, bbox[2] + pad),
            min(img.height, bbox[3] + pad),
        )
        cropped = res.crop(box)
    else:
        cropped = res
    cropped.save(dest, "PNG")
    return cropped.size


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# TEMPLATE HELPERS (Strictly flat, shadowless, borderless)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def create_slide_canvas(prs: pptx.Presentation, bg_color: RGBColor):
    """Full-bleed flat canvas without borders or shadows."""
    slide = prs.slides.add_slide(prs.slide_layouts[6])
    bg = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, 0, 0, prs.slide_width, prs.slide_height)
    bg.fill.solid()
    bg.fill.fore_color.rgb = bg_color
    bg.line.fill.background()
    return slide


def add_flat_card(slide, left: Inches, top: Inches, width: Inches, height: Inches, fill_color: RGBColor):
    """Flat solid card surface."""
    card = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height)
    card.fill.solid()
    card.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    card.line.fill.background()
    return card


def add_single_topic_content(
    slide,
    kicker: str,
    headline: str,
    subtitle: str,
    takeaways: list[tuple[str, str]],
    scheme: dict,
):
    """Clean, decluttered single-topic layout."""
    left = Inches(1.2)
    top = Inches(0.9)

    # 1. Kicker
    tb_k = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, Inches(10.5), Inches(0.4))
    tf_k = tb_k.text_frame

def add_single_metric_content(
    slide,
    kicker: str,
    metric_number: str,
    headline: str,
    detail: str,
    scheme: dict,
):
    """Massive, bold single-metric layout."""
    left = Inches(1.2)

    tb_k = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, Inches(10.5), Inches(0.4))

def build_presentation(work_dir: Path):
    prs = pptx.Presentation()
    prs.slide_width = Inches(13.333)
    prs.slide_height = Inches(7.5)

    # Generate smooth recolored wordmark for Yeast cover
    cover_mark_path = work_dir / "cover_wordmark.png"
    px_w, px_h = create_recolored_wordmark(
        ROOT / "brand" / "logo.png", cover_mark_path, (226, 75, 255)
    )

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # SLIDE 1: Minimalist Cover (Identical to PDF Page 1)
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    s_yeast = SCHEMES["yeast"]
    slide1 = create_slide_canvas(prs, s_yeast["secondary"])

    # Centered Wordmark
    mark_w = Inches(5.8)
    mark_h = mark_w * (px_h / px_w)
    mark_x = (prs.slide_width - mark_w) / 2
    mark_y = Inches(2.3)
    slide1.shapes.add_picture(str(cover_mark_path), mark_x, mark_y, width=mark_w, height=mark_h)

    # Centered Tagline
    tb_tag = slide1.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(1.5), mark_y + mark_h + Inches(0.3), Inches(10.333), Inches(0.8))
    tf_tag = tb_tag.text_frame
    tf_tag.word_wrap = False
    p_tag = tf_tag.paragraphs[0]
    p_tag.text = "PEEL. PRESS. TOAST."
    p_tag.font.name = "Manrope"
    p_tag.font.size = Pt(28)
    p_tag.font.bold = True
    p_tag.font.color.rgb = s_yeast["primary"]
    p_tag.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER

    # Centered Commercial Business Pitch at bottom
    tb_bot = slide1.shapes.add_textbox(Inches(1.5), Inches(6.4), Inches(10.333), Inches(0.6))
    tf_bot = tb_bot.text_frame
    tf_bot.word_wrap = False
    p_bot = tf_bot.paragraphs[0]
    p_bot.text = "Commercial Business Pitch"
    p_bot.font.name = "Manrope"
    p_bot.font.size = Pt(16)
    p_bot.font.color.rgb = s_yeast["white"]
    p_bot.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER

    slide1.notes_slide.notes_text_frame.text = (
        "TITLE SLIDE (0:00–0:08)\n"
        "Kia ora. I'm Jacob, and this is Stamp: a New Zealand breakfast spread innovation engineered for hot toast."
    )

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # SECTION 1: Product Innovation & Problem (Scheme: Butter)
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    s_butter = SCHEMES["butter"]

    # Slide 2: The Infrastructure Problem
    slide2 = create_slide_canvas(prs, s_butter["secondary"])
    add_single_topic_content(
        slide2,
        kicker="01 / THE PROBLEM  •  PITCH PART 1",
        headline="Jars Require Infrastructure.",
        subtitle="Table knives, kitchen counters, and sink washing. Breakfast away from home is broken.",
        takeaways=[
            ("Cutlery Dependency", "Office breakrooms, university halls, and student flats lack clean table knives and preparation space."),
            ("Stationary & Bulky", "Heavy 750 g glass jars sit immobile in cupboards rather than travelling conveniently in work bags."),
        ],
        scheme=s_butter,
    )
    slide2.notes_slide.notes_text_frame.text = (
        "PROBLEM SLIDE (0:08–0:18)\n"
        "Eating toast away from a full kitchen is broken. When you're in a student hall, flat, "
        "or office desk, nobody wants to lug a sticky 750-gram jar, track down a table knife, "
        "and wash it in an office sink."
    )

    # Slide 3: The Solution (Peel & Press Format)
    slide3 = create_slide_canvas(prs, s_butter["secondary"])
    add_single_topic_content(
        slide3,
        kicker="02 / THE SOLUTION  •  PITCH PART 1",
        headline="10 g Spread Disc on Release Film.",
        subtitle="Peel it off. Press onto hot toast. Residual thermal energy softens it in seconds.",
        takeaways=[
            ("Thermal Melt Gesture", "Residual heat from toasted bread softens the disc into an even, velvety layer with zero cutlery."),
            ("Calibrated Portion Control", "Pre-portioned 10 g servings eliminate cross-contamination, messy sticky jars, and food waste."),
        ],
        scheme=s_butter,
    )
    slide3.notes_slide.notes_text_frame.text = (
        "SOLUTION SLIDE (0:18–0:28)\n"
        "Stamp reinvents the format with a thin, 10-gram disc of real spread on release film. "
        "You peel it off, press it onto hot toast, and residual heat softens it into an even spread in seconds."
    )

    # Slide 4: Format & Stability
    slide4 = create_slide_canvas(prs, s_butter["secondary"])
    add_single_topic_content(
        slide4,
        kicker="03 / THE FORMAT  •  PITCH PART 1",
        headline="12-Month Ambient Pantry Life.",
        subtitle="Pocketable 8-stamp card sheets. Verified ambient stability with zero refrigeration.",
        takeaways=[
            ("Continuous Deposit Packaging", "Hermetically sealed card sheets protect against moisture and air, maintaining 12-month ambient shelf life."),
            ("Four Launch Varieties", "Salted Butter, Wild Raspberry whole fruit paste, Savoury Yeast extract, and Roasted Peanut."),
        ],
        scheme=s_butter,
    )
    slide4.notes_slide.notes_text_frame.text = (
        "FORMAT SLIDE (0:28–0:34)\n"
        "We launch with four distinct flavours: Salted Butter, Raspberry, Yeast extract, and Peanut—"
        "pantry-stable for 12 months in an 8-stamp card sheet."
    )

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # SECTION 2: Market Opportunity & Unit Economics (Scheme: Raspberry)
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    s_berry = SCHEMES["raspberry"]

    # Slide 5: Market Scale
    slide5 = create_slide_canvas(prs, s_berry["secondary"])
    add_single_metric_content(
        slide5,
        kicker="04 / MARKET SCALE  •  PITCH PART 2",
        metric_number="$341M",
        headline="New Zealand Spreads Category.",
        detail="+24% category revenue growth (2022–2025). Premium branded spreads surged +29% to $113M NZD.",
        scheme=s_berry,
    )
    slide5.notes_slide.notes_text_frame.text = (
        "MARKET SCALE SLIDE (0:34–0:42)\n"
        "Our analysis of New Zealand breakfast retail sales shows spreads revenue grew 24% to 341 million dollars, "
        "with the premium tier surging 29% to 113 million."
    )

    # Slide 6: The Competitive Format Void
    slide6 = create_slide_canvas(prs, s_berry["secondary"])
    add_single_metric_content(
        slide6,
        kicker="05 / COMPETITIVE VOID  •  PITCH PART 2",
        metric_number="0 Rivals",
        headline="Across 154 Supermarket Spreads.",
        detail="Not a single brand offers a utensil-free single-serve format. Jars compete on bulk weight; Stamp wins on convenience.",
        scheme=s_berry,
    )
    slide6.notes_slide.notes_text_frame.text = (
        "COMPETITIVE VOID SLIDE (0:42–0:50)\n"
        "Yet across 154 existing spread products, not one offers a single-serve portion format. "
        "Supermarket jars like Pic's or Fix & Fogg compete on bulk weight, but they are messy and stationary."
    )

    # Slide 7: Unit Economics
    slide7 = create_slide_canvas(prs, s_berry["secondary"])
    add_single_metric_content(
        slide7,
        kicker="06 / UNIT ECONOMICS  •  PITCH PART 2",
        metric_number="$1.75 Margin",
        headline="$5.00 NZD per 8-Stamp Sheet.",
        detail="Just 63¢ per toast serving. At an assumed $1.50 contract manufacturing cost and 35% retail margin, Stamp captures $1.75 contribution.",
        scheme=s_berry,
    )
    slide7.notes_slide.notes_text_frame.text = (
        "ECONOMICS SLIDE (0:50–0:58)\n"
        "At five dollars a sheet—just 63 cents a toast portion—Stamp captures premium convenience. With an assumed "
        "manufacturing cost of one-fifty, we retain a strong one-dollar-seventy-five gross margin per sheet. "
        "Stamp is ready to own portable breakfast."
    )

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # SECTION 3: Reflection 1 — AI Steering & Verification (Scheme: Peanut)
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    s_peanut = SCHEMES["peanut"]

    # Slide 8: Context Steering & Negative Bans
    slide8 = create_slide_canvas(prs, s_peanut["secondary"])
    add_single_topic_content(
        slide8,
        kicker="07 / REFLECTION  •  CONTEXT STEERING",
        headline="Strict Negative Constraints.",
        subtitle="Banning hallucinated health claims and partitioning sessions to prevent context drift.",
        takeaways=[
            ("Negative Prompt Guards", "Enforcing strict bans against therapeutic health benefits and fake organic badges eliminated marketing fluff."),
            ("Session Partitioning", "Isolating data cleaning, brand spec, and copywriting into modular sessions eliminated context decay."),
        ],
        scheme=s_peanut,
    )
    slide8.notes_slide.notes_text_frame.text = (
        "REFLECTION SLIDE 1 (1:00–1:20)\n"
        "To steer generative AI effectively, I structured distinct sessions rather than one massive chat, and "
        "enforced strict negative constraints against fake certification badges and medical claims."
    )

    # Slide 9: The Pivotal Turning Point
    slide9 = create_slide_canvas(prs, s_peanut["secondary"])
    add_single_topic_content(
        slide9,
        kicker="08 / REFLECTION  •  TURNING POINT",
        headline="Catching Butter Instability.",
        subtitle="Rejecting unrealistic model assumptions about ambient dairy shelf life.",
        takeaways=[
            ("The Hallucinated Assumption", "AI assumed standard churned butter could sit ambiently in a pantry for 12 months without spoiling."),
            ("The Human Formulation Pivot", "Caught the food science flaw and forced reformulation into a cultured dairy spread to ensure shelf stability."),
        ],
        scheme=s_peanut,
    )
    slide9.notes_slide.notes_text_frame.text = (
        "TURNING POINT SLIDE (1:20–1:40)\n"
        "My key pivotal moment was catching an unrealistic AI assumption that dairy butter could sit ambiently without spoilage. "
        "I intervened to enforce a shelf-stable cultured dairy spread formula."
    )

    # Slide 10: Verification & Fact-Checking
    slide10 = create_slide_canvas(prs, s_peanut["secondary"])
    add_single_topic_content(
        slide10,
        kicker="09 / REFLECTION  •  VERIFICATION",
        headline="AI as Drafter, Not Director.",
        subtitle="Auditing raw retail scan outliers and independently verifying competitor prices.",
        takeaways=[
            ("Data Cleaning Audits", "Manually audited raw breakfast sales data to catch aberrant price outliers (>$40) and formula errors."),
            ("Live Shelf Benchmarks", "Directly cross-referenced New World retail prices (Pic's $7.79, Fix & Fogg $11.99) rather than trusting AI estimates."),
        ],
        scheme=s_peanut,
    )
    slide10.notes_slide.notes_text_frame.text = (
        "VERIFICATION SLIDE (1:40–1:55)\n"
        "I audited raw supermarket scan data to spot price outliers and independently verified competitor prices on New World "
        "rather than blindly trusting model calculations."
    )

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    # SECTION 4: Reflection 2 — Authenticity, AI Slop & Ethics (Scheme: Yeast)
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
    s_yeast = SCHEMES["yeast"]

    # Slide 11: Combating AI Slop
    slide11 = create_slide_canvas(prs, s_yeast["secondary"])
    add_single_topic_content(
        slide11,
        kicker="10 / REFLECTION  •  AUTHENTICITY",
        headline="Banning Corporate Buzzwords.",
        subtitle="Stripping hyperbolic marketing cliches for punchy facts: Peel. Press. Toast.",
        takeaways=[
            ("Rejecting Slop Phrases", "Actively stripped generic corporate fluff ('game-changer', 'revolutionary journey') to maintain authentic tone."),
            ("Physical Reality Grounding", "Anchored packaging in real industrial tooling (continuous deposit, release film) rather than AI fantasy mockups."),
        ],
        scheme=s_yeast,
    )
    slide11.notes_slide.notes_text_frame.text = (
        "AUTHENTICITY SLIDE (1:55–2:15)\n"
        "To combat AI slop, I actively stripped out corporate buzzwords in favour of plain, punchy facts, and "
        "grounded packaging in real physical manufacturing constraints."
    )

    # Slide 12: Food Regulation & Allergen Responsibility
    slide12 = create_slide_canvas(prs, s_yeast["secondary"])
    add_single_topic_content(
        slide12,
        kicker="11 / REFLECTION  •  REGULATION",
        headline="Zero Hallucination Tolerance.",
        subtitle="Strict FSANZ food compliance and non-negotiable allergen disclosures.",
        takeaways=[
            ("The Legal Hazard", "Unchecked AI frequently invents fake organic labels or dangerous 'gluten-free' badges (hazardous for Yeast extract)."),
            ("Enforcing Standards", "Complied strictly with Food Standards Australia New Zealand and ensured peanut and gluten warnings remained prominent."),
        ],
        scheme=s_yeast,
    )
    slide12.notes_slide.notes_text_frame.text = (
        "REGULATION SLIDE (2:15–2:30)\n"
        "In food and beverage, AI hallucinations are a severe legal hazard. I enforced strict compliance with "
        "New Zealand Food Standards and ensured life-threatening allergen warnings were never obscured."
    )

    # Slide 13: Human Accountability
    slide13 = create_slide_canvas(prs, s_yeast["secondary"])
    add_single_topic_content(
        slide13,
        kicker="12 / REFLECTION  •  ETHICS",
        headline="Accountability Remains Human.",
        subtitle="Legal, moral, and customer responsibility can never be outsourced to an algorithm.",
        takeaways=[
            ("Non-Delegable Agency", "When deploying AI commercially, accountability for safety and truth rests entirely with the human practitioner."),
            ("The Core Worker Value", "Critical thinking, skepticism, taste, and verification are the irreplaceable skills of future knowledge workers."),
        ],
        scheme=s_yeast,
    )
    slide13.notes_slide.notes_text_frame.text = (
        "ETHICS SLIDE (2:30–2:50)\n"
        "Ultimately, accountability can never be outsourced to a model. Generative AI accelerates execution, "
        "but human judgment, taste, skepticism, and moral ownership remain essential."
    )

    OUT_PPTX.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    prs.save(str(OUT_PPTX))
    print(f"Successfully generated {OUT_PPTX} (13 decluttered slides)")


def main():
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="stamp-slides-") as tmpdir:
        build_presentation(Path(tmpdir))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

# Stamp Video Presentation — Timing & Script Sheet

**Course:** INFO123 Business AI Project  
**Deliverable:** 2–3 Minute Video Presentation (`.mp4` / `.mov` in Talking-Head format)  
**Strict Requirements:**  
- **Hard stop:** Must conclude before 3m29s (exceeding 3m29s forfeits excellence grades).
- **Pitch limit:** Part 1 (Investor Pitch) must be 1 minute maximum (strict).
- **Format:** Talking-head video (your face visible to camera alongside the slides).
- **AI restriction:** Part 2 (Personal Reflection) must be your own work in your own voice.
- **Slide Strategy:** Bite-sized, decluttered slides flicked through dynamically every 10–15 seconds.

---

## 13-Slide Dynamic Timing Breakdown

| Slide | Title & Topic | Target Time | Section / Palette |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Slide 01** | Cover (STAMP, Peel. Press. Toast.) | 0:00 – 0:08 | Cover • Yeast (`#240340`) |
| **Slide 02** | The Problem: Jars Require Infrastructure | 0:08 – 0:18 | Pitch 1 • Butter (`#4A3000`) |
| **Slide 03** | The Solution: 10g Spread Disc on Release Film | 0:18 – 0:28 | Pitch 1 • Butter (`#4A3000`) |
| **Slide 04** | The Format: 12-Month Ambient Life | 0:28 – 0:34 | Pitch 1 • Butter (`#4A3000`) |
| **Slide 05** | Market Scale: $341M Category (+24% Growth) | 0:34 – 0:42 | Pitch 2 • Raspberry (`#460820`) |
| **Slide 06** | Competitive Void: 0 Rivals Across 154 SKUs | 0:42 – 0:50 | Pitch 2 • Raspberry (`#460820`) |
| **Slide 07** | Unit Economics: $1.75 Margin / $5.00 Sheet | 0:50 – 0:58 | Pitch 2 • Raspberry (`#460820`) |
| **Transition** | Pitch Hard Cutoff | 0:58 – 1:00 | Hard pitch limit at 60s |
| **Slide 08** | AI Steering: Strict Negative Constraints | 1:00 – 1:20 | Reflection 1 • Peanut (`#4E2408`) |
| **Slide 09** | Turning Point: Catching Butter Instability | 1:20 – 1:40 | Reflection 1 • Peanut (`#4E2408`) |
| **Slide 10** | Verification: AI as Drafter, Not Director | 1:40 – 1:55 | Reflection 1 • Peanut (`#4E2408`) |
| **Slide 11** | Authenticity: Banning Corporate Buzzwords | 1:55 – 2:15 | Reflection 2 • Yeast (`#240340`) |
| **Slide 12** | Food Regulation: Zero Hallucination Tolerance | 2:15 – 2:30 | Reflection 2 • Yeast (`#240340`) |
| **Slide 13** | Ethics: Human Accountability Remains Core | 2:30 – 2:50 | Reflection 2 • Yeast (`#240340`) |

---

## Part 1: Investor Pitch Script (0:00 – 0:58)

### Slide 01: Cover (0:00 – 0:08)
> "Kia ora. I'm Jacob, and this is Stamp: a New Zealand breakfast spread innovation engineered for hot toast."

### Slide 02: Problem — Jars Require Infrastructure (0:08 – 0:18)
> "Eating toast away from a full kitchen is broken. When you're in a student hall, flat, or office desk, nobody wants to lug a sticky 750-gram jar, track down a table knife, and wash it in an office sink."

### Slide 03: Solution — 10g Spread Disc on Release Film (0:18 – 0:28)
> "Stamp reinvents the format with a thin, 10-gram disc of real spread on release film. You peel it off, press it onto hot toast, and residual thermal energy melts it into an even spread in seconds. No knife, no open jar, no morning mess."

### Slide 04: Format — 12-Month Ambient Life (0:28 – 0:34)
> "We launch with four distinct flavours—Salted Butter, Raspberry, Yeast extract, and Peanut—pantry-stable for 12 months in an 8-stamp card sheet."

### Slide 05: Market Scale — $341M Category (0:34 – 0:42)
> "Our analysis of New Zealand retail scan data shows the spreads category expanded 24% to 341 million dollars, with the premium tier surging 29% to 113 million."

### Slide 06: Competitive Void — 0 Rivals (0:42 – 0:50)
> "Yet across 154 existing spread products, not one offers a single-serve portion format. Supermarket jars compete on bulk weight, but they are messy and stationary."

### Slide 07: Economics — $1.75 Margin per Sheet (0:50 – 0:58)
> "At five dollars a sheet—just 63 cents a toast portion—Stamp captures premium convenience. With an assumed manufacturing cost of one-fifty, we retain a strong one-dollar-seventy-five gross margin per sheet. Stamp is ready to own portable breakfast."

*(Transition to reflection at 1:00)*

---

## Part 2: Personal Reflection Speaking Cues (1:00 – 2:50)

*Deliver in your personal voice. AI assistance was strictly prohibited for reflection text.*

### Slide 08: Context Steering (1:00 – 1:20)
- Enforce strict negative constraints against fake certification badges and therapeutic health claims.
- Partition modular sessions (data cleaning, brand identity, copy) to eliminate context drift.

### Slide 09: Turning Point (1:20 – 1:40)
- Highlight catching the AI's unrealistic assumption that dairy butter could sit ambiently without spoilage.
- Explain intervening to formulate a shelf-stable cultured dairy spread to meet the 12-month pantry requirement.

### Slide 10: Verification (1:40 – 1:55)
- Describe auditing raw retail scan data to identify >$40 price anomalies and formula sum errors.
- Emphasize checking real shelf prices independently on New World for Pic's and Fix & Fogg.

### Slide 11: Authenticity (1:55 – 2:15)
- Detail actively stripping hyperbolic marketing cliches ("game-changer", "revolutionary breakfast journey") in favor of plain facts: "Peel. Press. Toast."
- Ground product specifications in real packaging engineering (continuous deposit, release film) rather than AI fantasy mockups.

### Slide 12: Food Regulation (2:15 – 2:30)
- Explain the severe legal hazards of AI in food and beverage: hallucinated organic certifications or false "gluten-free" badges.
- Describe enforcing strict compliance with Food Standards Australia New Zealand (FSANZ) and prominent allergen warnings.

### Slide 13: Human Accountability (2:30 – 2:50)
- Conclude with your takeaway: Generative AI accelerates drafting velocity, but human skepticism, taste, discernment, and ultimate accountability can never be outsourced to a model.
